To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ypt1 mutant cells have defective Golgi apparatus and that this defect can be overcome by wild-type cytosolic components.
mutations in the YPT1 gene disrupt transport in vitro and the Golgi apparatus of yeast cells.
mutations in the yeast GTP-binding protein gene YPT1 result in a defect in Golgi function in vitro and in vivo.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the GTP-binding protein encoded by YPT1 in transport through the Golgi complex.
the function of Ypt1p in the transport of proteins to and through the yeast Golgi apparatus.
the mechanism of vesicular transport from the endoplasmical reticulum to the Golgi apparatus and from the Golgi apparatus to the vacuoles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Ypt1p is required for vesicular transport between compartments in yeast.
the GTP-binding protein encoded by YPT1 is required for the transport of secretory proteins through the Golgi complex.
the YPT1 gene product is a GTP-binding protein required for transport in yeast cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the GTP-binding protein encoded by YPT1 is essential for the normal function of the Gol-gi apparatus in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

YPT1 is required for growth and for transport in vivo and in vitro, and that YPT1 functions in a pathway that includes at least three other genes required for the transport of proteins to and through the yeast Golgi apparatus.
YPT1 encodes a protein that is essential both for transport of proteins through the Golgi complex in vivo and for the function of the Goldi apparatus in vitro.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Ypt1 is a key component of the machinery responsible for transport between the endoplasmically reticulum and the Golgi apparatus.
the Ypt1 GTPase is essential for Golgi function.
the Ypt1 protein is required for transport of proteins to the Golgi apparatus, and the Golgi apparatus itself is defective in ytp1 mutants.
